text:
Leo (Support): Quick escalation: ZenWell trial ingest failing with 403/quota_inactive since 09:23 PT. They're mid-onboarding and have a renewal check-in in 9 days. Flagging to CS as high priority :bangbang:

Asha (CSM): Thanks Leo. Paste repro + account id so I can prep comms.

Leo (Support): Account: zenwell-202
Repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_zen_***' -d '{"input":"note text"}'
HTTP/1.1 403
{"error":"quota_inactive","detail":"no_active_quota"}
```

Priya (CS Ops): Checked admin: zenwell-202 shows plan=trial, active_quota=0, billing_status=payment_failed. Likely provisioning/payment gap.

Marta (AE): Champion said pilot must finish this week to decide. If onboarding stalls they may defer or walk. High-touch.

Asha (CSM): Short playbook: 1) Temp quota bump (Ops) 2) Send brief customer note + schedule 20m sync (CS/AE/PM) 3) Open internal ticket with logs and customer feedback 4) Billing recovery flow. Owners: Priya, Leo, Asha, Marta.

Priya (CS Ops): Requesting temp quota now. ETA ~15m. Logging audit as temp-unblock-zenwell-202.

BillingBot: Billing note for zenwell-202: last_payment=card_declined. Recovery email queued to finance@zenwell.com at 1920001175.

Leo (Support): Noted in logs they attempted a very large batch (batch_size=400) causing immediate quota burn. Recommend including batch guidance in onboarding docs.

Priya (CS Ops): Temp quota applied at 1920001290: +50k vectors/day for 72h. Audit recorded.

Leo (Support): Verified with customer after bump: embeddings now succeed. They report throughput improves after reducing batch_size to 24.

Asha (CSM): Next steps:
- Leo: send 20m invite for tomorrow 9:30 AM PT and include PM
- Priya: follow up with Billing for payment recovery and perm quota restore
- Asha: open PM ticket with repro, logs, and feature asks (default batch controls, trial SLA, embedding presets)
- Marta: prepare a short commercial note on upgrade/reserved option for the call

Marta (AE): On it. I'll add a slide showing reserved capacity latency guarantees.

Leo (Support): From support POV this is resolved. Leaving thread open for CS follow-ups and billing.

Asha (CSM): Thanks all. I'll post the customer comms and meeting notes back here after the call. :thumbsup:
